name: clinica-t1-volume
description:
Volume-based processing of T1-weighted MR images.

   GROUP_LABEL is an user-defined identifier to target a specific group of subjects.

https://aramislab.paris.inria.fr/clinica/docs/public/latest/Pipelines/T1_Volume/

inputs.description: Specify the different isomorphic FWHM in millimeters to smooth the image.
inputs.name: smooth

inputs.description: TSV file containing a list of subjects with their sessions.
inputs.name: subjects_sessions_tsv

inputs.description: Temporary directory to store pipelines intermediate results.
inputs.name: working_directory

inputs.description: Tissue classes (1: gray matter (GM), 2: white matter (WM), 3: cerebrospinal fluid (CSF), 4: bone, 5: soft-tissue, 6: background) to save.
inputs.name: tissue_classes

inputs.description: Tissue probability maps to use for segmentation.
inputs.name: tissue_probability_maps

inputs.description: Do not save warped unmodulated images for tissues specified in --tissue_classes flag.
inputs.name: dont_save_warped_unmodulated

inputs.description: Save warped modulated images for tissues specified in --tissue_classes flag.
inputs.name: save_warped_modulated

inputs.description: Tissues to use for DARTEL template calculation.
inputs.name: dartel_tissues

inputs.description: Tissues to create flow fields to DARTEL template.
inputs.name: tissues

inputs.description: Modulate output images, no modulation preserves concentrations.
inputs.name: modulate

inputs.description: Specifying the voxel sizes of the output image.
inputs.name: voxel_size

inputs.description: Number of cores used to run in parallel.
inputs.name: n_procs

inputs.description: The name of the CAPS dataset that will be created by the pipeline. This is not the name of the folder itself, but the name in the metadata, which can be different if desired. If the CAPS folder already exists and already has a name, this will have no effect and the existing name will be kept.
inputs.name: caps_name
